title: Skill or plugin entry
description: Shape of one entry in data/skills.json or data/plugins.json. Documented here for reference; scripts/validate-data.mjs enforces the same rules by hand rather than through a JSON Schema library, to keep this repo's zero-npm-dependency CI.

name.description: Display name, e.g. "author/repo" or "author/repo - skill-name" for a skill inside a monorepo.

url.description: Link target. Must appear exactly once across data/skills.json + data/plugins.json combined.

description.description: One line, roughly 10 words or fewer, verb-first, ends with a period. Does not include the 🔑/🌐 marker -- that's the separate `marker` field.

category.description: Must match an existing README.md section heading exactly.

marker.description: null for no marker. "requires-key" renders as the 🔑 prefix (needs a paid API key/account). "external-service" renders as the 🌐 prefix (always calls a live external service, no key needed).

supported_tools.description: Which of the four tools in the Compatibility Paths table this entry is built for. Defaults to ["claude-code", "cursor", "copilot"] for a plain SKILL.md-style entry; only entries with a specific, verified reason (like gemini-cli-extensions/datacommons shipping a gemini-extension.json instead of a SKILL.md) diverge from that default. This is a documented baseline, not a claim every entry has been individually spot-checked against every tool -- see issue #96.
